incompatible_dfl_slice_nodes.proposed_handling: Exclude DFL sub-graph from NPU graph; expose raw bounding box distribution [1, 64, 8400] and class probabilities [1, 3, 8400] directly as model outputs. Perform DFL decoding in C++ worker.
